dek: An incoming male passenger was sentenced to four months' imprisonment and fined $1,000 at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts yesterday (August 20) for possessing duty-not-paid cigarettes and failing to declare them to Customs officers, in contravention of the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance (DCO).
